text:
arjun: quick heads-up — we're planning a staggered onboarding for three open models into the catalog: fenrir-6b-open (miriam), ember-3.2b (samir), willow-small (celine). Targeting catalog gate on Tue. Need a fast checklist: licensing ok, perf profile + quantization notes, canary schedule, infra deps. call out blockers pls.

miriam: fenrir: licensing cleared yesterday (license: Apache-2.0-like, added to registry). perf: CPU fallback has slow tails, but GPU quantized path looks good. working on a short perf doc. main blocker: tokenizer edge-cases for some non-ascii prompts. will push tests by EOD.

samir: ember: license pending legal signoff (source has mixed components). perf profiles done on p4d and g5; 95p latency good under batching. need a quick check from infra about peak memory for KV cache when seq=2048. tagging @tony infra.

celine: willow-small: tiny model, perf trivial. question on whether we should publish it as a 'preview' variant or full catalog entry — prefer preview to avoid quota surprises. also need a recommended quant config (int8) from eng-runtime.

legal-bot: @samir I see the mixed components flag. @jess-legal to review. ETA requested: 2 business days. Please attach provenance file and contributor list.

jess: on it. can take ember review tomorrow morning. @samir drop the dependency list here and I'll prioritize.

tony: infra check: fenrir KV warmup might spike to ~24GB on a single shard with seq=4k. for seq=2048 it looks ~12GB. we can set canary shard size to 8GB to be safe, but need autoscaler bump for canaries.

arjun: thanks — sounds like actionable items. can each owner reply with a 1-line "ready / blocked" and the main blocker if any? also propose canary windows: fenrir -> Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC (low traffic), ember -> Fri 01:00-03:00 UTC, willow -> immediate preview roll.

miriam: fenrir: blocked -> tokenizer tests (I expect fix today, but want perf re-run).

samir: ember: blocked -> legal signoff (jess). infra mem check ok but will need autoscaler tweak (tony).

celine: willow: ready -> preview ok. will add preview tag in manifest.

arjun: devex note — if willow is preview, pls include "preview" in the catalog metadata and add a short caveat on quotas. @devex-bot can you add template note?

devex-bot: added preview template to the onboarding checklist: 
```
- metadata.preview: true
- quota_comment: "Preview tier - reduced quota by default, request increase via support."
- perf_profile: link to perf doc
```

arjun: perf profiles: miriam/samir pls drop perf doc links when ready. we need token-throughput, p95/p99, cost-per-1k-tokens, and recommended quant flags.

miriam: will post perf doc link after tests (EOD). includes int8 baseline + int4 experiment notes.

samir: ember perf doc uploaded: https://internal/redwood/perf/ember-3.2b - includes p95/p99 on p4d and g5, and cost estimates.

jess: legal: ember looks ok pending one CLA clar. i'll update the ticket.

arjun: final ask — owners, update the catalog intake checklist items: licensing (Y/N), perf doc (link), canary window (time), infra tweaks required (Y/N). I'll compile and forward to product for launch gating.

miriam: fenrir: licensing Y, perf doc soon (link pending), canary Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC, infra tweaks Y (tokenizer test + perf re-run).

samir: ember: licensing pending (CLA), perf doc https://internal/redwood/perf/ember-3.2b, canary Fri 01:00-03:00 UTC, infra tweaks Y (autoscaler).

celine: willow: licensing Y (MIT), perf doc minimal (small model), canary immediate preview, infra tweaks N.

arjun: great — I'll mark fenrir and ember as "conditional" on fixes/signoff and willow as preview. product, ops, and support: FYI. anyone see a showstopper for the Tue catalog gate?

tonY: ops thumbs - single potential here: if fenrir tokenizer fix slips, it could delay fenrir by 24-48h but catalog can still ship willow + ember (if legal clears ember).

jess: legal will try to clear ember within 24h, I'll flag if not.

arjun: ok closing out — follow-ups:
- miriam: post tokenizer test results + perf doc link (by EOD).
- samir: drop dependency list + confirm legal attachments (tomorrow AM).
- celine: add preview metadata + short caveat (today).
- tony: autoscaler canary bump (before ember canary).
- jess: legal signoff timeline.

arjun: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
